purpose: Public requirements-corpus and SRS-template provenance. Records with unknown licensing are reference-only and cannot enter a model prompt or local corpus.

sources.title: PURE: a Dataset of Public Requirements Documents
sources.role: public-document structure and requirement-language evaluation; not an IEEE conformance oracle

quality_evidence.notes: Use its provenance and structure, not its business-domain content, for evaluation.

sources.attribution: Ferrari, A., Spagnolo, G. O., & Gnesi, S. (2017), PURE: a Dataset of Public Requirements Documents.

sources.title: PROMISE expanded non-functional-requirements dataset
sources.role: functional/non-functional classification and measurable-quality-requirement evaluation; not a complete SRS corpus

quality_evidence.notes: Class labels allow category checks; individual statements still need project-specific validation.

sources.attribution: PROMISE Software Engineering Repository dataset; Jane Cleland-Huang (2007); expanded dataset attribution retained.

sources.title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 SRS template
sources.license: repository license must be checked at fetch time
sources.role: section-structure cross-check for IEEE 830 / ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148-aligned SRS output

quality_evidence.notes: Formatting reference only; the paid ISO standard itself is never copied into this repository.

sources.title: GitReq: A Gold Standard Dataset for Software Quality Requirements
sources.role: quality-requirement rating evidence and ISO/IEC 25010 category cross-check; no download until the dataset licence is verified

quality_evidence.notes: The rating records evidence quality, not a licence grant.

sources.attribution: GitReq authors and dataset publication; retain the final source citation before any future import.
